<!-- A clear, detailed description of what feature or enhancement you would like to see added. -->

<!-- Describe the user interaction, keyboard shortcuts, UI presentation, or CLI flags. -->

### Fit with px0 Philosophy
<!-- px0 is intentionally:
     - Read-only (code reading & navigation, not editing)
     - Zero config & zero external runtime dependencies (single self-contained binary)
     - Extremely lightweight (low CPU and low RAM usage, fast startup)

     How does your proposed feature align with these principles? -->

### Target Environment & Use Case
<!-- If this feature is OS-specific, architecture-dependent, or relates to a specific environment, specify below.
     Tip: `px0 -version` gives your current version, OS, and Architecture (e.g. px0 0.1.0 (linux/amd64)). -->
- **Target OS / Architecture** (if relevant):
  - Linux (`uname -srm`)
  - macOS (`sw_vers` / `uname -srm`)
  - Windows (`winver` / PowerShell: `[System.Environment]::OSVersion`)
  - [ ] All platforms / OS-independent
- **Relevant Languages / Workspaces**: <!-- e.g., monorepos with 50k+ files, embedded C, Go, Python -->
